title: Complete the live Codex post-selection journey

requirement.summary: Use the current human-approved ephemeral Codex session to resolve the offered direction, validate Adapter 1.2.4, and complete bounded current-Agent self-review without starting another session or external replay.

objective.rationale: Alignment Start and installed post-selection contract preflight already pass, but the real host had not yet bound a human selection to Resolve and current-Agent self-review.

goal: Record the human-selected live post-selection direction in the current approved Codex session, validate the exact development source, and finish one evidence-bounded current-Agent advisory review.
non_goals: Do not start another Codex session, Agent, host, or external replay.
Do not retain raw prompts, transcripts, credentials, source content, host paths, or model-private reasoning.
Do not add product authority, modify NYC or another consumer, commit, push, publish, release, or deploy.
acceptance_signals: The current approved Codex session uses the native MCP journey and records the exact human-selected direction through Alignment Resolve.
Focused MCP and task-contract tests and the full supported-Python suite pass against the exact working source.
One distinct current-Agent self-review uses only the declared repository-relative evidence allow-list and returns bounded advisory observations.
Documentation distinguishes the measured live path from unproven automatic proposal generation, another host, consumer adoption, publication, or deployment.

items: A claim could overstate one current-session Resolve as automatic proposal generation or cross-host proof.
Self-review evidence could exceed its repository-relative allow-list or imply approval rather than advisory review.

stop_conditions: Stop if completion requires another Codex session, Agent, external replay, consumer mutation, or expanded authority.
Stop if a required governance call fails or validation reveals a product failure that cannot be corrected inside this bounded scope.
Stop rather than retain raw replay material or overstate the measured journey.

decision.rationale: The current approved Codex session bound the human-selected direction through Resolve, passed validation, and completed the evidence-bounded current-Agent advisory review; the task is paused for product-owner review before any next requirement.
